title: myosotis ramosissima subsp. lebelii
intro: Myosotis ramosissima subsp. lebelii, commonly known as Alpine forget-me-not, is a plant species belonging to the genus Myosotis. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, thereby offering relief from conditions such as arthritis and neurodegenerative diseases. The therapeutic actions of M. ramosissima subsp. lebelii include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as a neuroprotective agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
